[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Amount: 10
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- Description: 10 minutes following up with the CIC (Centro de Inovacao do Cacau, Ilheus/BA - the only MAPA-accredited lab in Brazil for official cacao bean classification) on the heavy-metal and flavonoid lab reports for the Black King cacao lot.
  
  Portuguese WhatsApp thread with 'Cacao Innovation Center':
  
  1. CIC's earlier reply (6:42 AM): 'Obrigado!!' - then supplied AVERAGE REFERENCE VALUES: 'Valores medios: Teobromina: 20mg/g; Cafeina: 2 mg/g' (average values: theobromine 20 mg/g, caffeine 2 mg/g).
  
  2. Gary, 11:49 AM: 'Voce poderia me enviar um exemplo de como seria o relatorio da analise de flavonoides, cafeina e teobromina?' - i.e. Gary requested a SAMPLE/TEMPLATE of what the flavonoids + caffeine + theobromine analysis report would look like, so he can see the report format before commissioning the full panel.
  
  3. Gary, 11:50 AM: Attached 'NFSe 0097 Venda 120634 Black King.pdf' (the Brazilian service invoice for invoice/sale no. 120634, Black King) and asked: 'Gostaria de saber o resultado do teste para 6 metais pesados?' - i.e. he wants the RESULT of the 6-heavy-metals test.
  
  So two live asks are now with CIC: (a) a sample flavonoid/caffeine/theobromine report template, and (b) the actual 6-heavy-metal test results.
  
  STRATEGIC SIGNIFICANCE: this closes the exact data gap that the DAO's own analysis (CACAO_IN_QUANTIFIED_BIOHACKING.md) identifies as the binding constraint on the entire quantified-health / biohacking lane. Heavy metals (Pb, Cd, As and Hg) per lot with a COA is described there as 'the disqualifier: an unmeasured cadmium risk is uninsurable for a buyer whose whole brand is measurement', and the flavanols figure is gate one because without a number the product cannot be dosed, compared or priced per mg. A CIC-issued laudo covering flavanols + heavy metals per lot is precisely the certificate the Blueprint-tier buyer demands. Note the existing Oscar lab report (14215834_gary_teh_oscar_lab_report.pdf) covered only As, Cd, Pb and Cu by ICP-MS against ANVISA IN 160 - no Hg, no flavonols - so this 6-metal test plus the flavonoid/ methylxanthine panel materially extends it.
  
  Also of note: CIC quoting AVERAGE REFERENCE values rather than lot-specific results means the theobromine/caffeine numbers are not yet measurements of this lot - the 20 mg/g and 2 mg/g are benchmarlk figures, and should not be quoted as Black King's actual results.
- Type: Time (Minutes)
--------
